item.title: Machine learning-assisted design and explainable optimization of CdSnP2-based integrated solar-photodetector devices
item.description: arXiv:2609.03642v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: CdSnP2-based integrated solar cell-photodetector (SC-PD) devices employing CdS and CuGaSe2 (CGS) as the window and back surface field (BSF) layers, respectively are investigated using a hybrid machine learning (ML)-assisted SCAPS-1D framework. Device optimization is performed by varying the thickness, doping concentration, and defect density of individual layers. item.title: Fluid motion and crystallization control enable air-processed fully screen-printed perovskite solar cells
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 27 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01991-3 Solvent engineering optimizes fluid motion and crystallization in fully screen-printed perovskite solar cells, resulting in devices with a certified power conversion efficiency of 21.86%, 90.5% of which is maintained after 2,000 h of operation.
